summary.text: Jacob Braud is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 105, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson, Orleans, and Plaquemines parishes. First elected in 2023, Jacob Braud sits on the Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, and Transportation, Highways and Public Works committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jacob Braud's occupation as attorney, with a B.A. in mass communications from Louisiana State University (1999) and a J.D. from Loyola University New Orleans College of Law (2002).

The House page lists Jacob Braud's committee assignments as Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and Orleans Delegation.
